verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              कृतवर्मा कृपो द्रौणिः सूतपुत्रश्च मारिष । उलूकः सौबलश्चैव राजा च सह सोदरैः ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Beholding the Kuru army afflicted with the fear of Pandu's son sinking like a boat foundered in the ocean, Kritavarma, Kripa, Drona's son, Suta's son, Ulaka, Subala's son Shakuni and the king himself with his brother, came to their rescue.

verses.sanskrit: सीदमानां चमूं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डुपुत्रभयार्दिताम् । समुज्जह्रुः स्म वेगेन भिन्नां नावमिवार्णवे ॥२॥
ततो युद्धमतीवासीन्मुहूर्तमिव भारत । भीरूणां त्रासजननं शूराणां हर्षवर्धनम् ॥३॥
verses.english: Then there took place an encounter for the time being capable of striking terror unto the timid and increasing the delight of the heroes.

verses.sanskrit: कृपेण शरवर्षाणि प्रतिमुक्तानि संयुगे । सृञ्जयांश्छादयामासुः शलभानां व्रजा इव ॥४॥
verses.english: The downpour of arrows made by Kripa in the battle covered the Srinjayas like a swarm of locusts.

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डी च ततः क्रुद्धो गौतमं त्वरितो ययौ । ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि समन्ताद्द्विजपुङ्गवम् ॥५॥
verses.english: Thereupon Shikhandin, worked up with anger, speedily approached the son of Gautaina and discharged a shower of arrows upon that best of men.

verses.sanskrit: कृपस्तु शरवर्षं तद्विनिहत्य महास्त्रवित् । शिखण्डिनं रणे क्रुद्धो विव्याध दशभिः शरैः ॥६॥
verses.english: And checking that downpour of arrows Kripa, conversant with the use of mighty weapons and filled with anger, struck in that encounter Shikhandin with ten arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततः शिखण्डी कुपितः शरैः सप्तभिराहवे । कृपं विव्याध कुपितं कङ्कपत्रैरजिह्मगैः ॥७॥
verses.english: Then Shikhandin, worked up with anger, pierced Kripa and seven straight Kankafeathered arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कृपः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः सोऽतिविद्धो महारथः । व्यश्वसूतरथं चक्रे शिखण्डिनमथो द्विजः ॥८॥
verses.english: Then the Brahmana Kripa, a mighty carwarrior, piercing heavily with sharp arrows, deprived Shikhandin of his horses, charioteer and car.

verses.sanskrit: हताश्वात्तु ततो यानादवप्लुत्य महारथः । खड्गं चर्म तथा गृह्य सत्वरं ब्राह्मणं ययौ ॥९॥
verses.english: Then jumping down from the car, the heroes of which were slain, the mighty carwarrior speedily took up his sword and armour and approached the Brahmana.

verses.sanskrit: तमापतन्तं सहसा शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः । छादयामास समरे तद‌द्भुतमिवाभवत् ॥१०॥
verses.english: On the other hand, Shahadeva, as if laughing, had suddenly thrown down that sword with keen arrows, that was directed towards him.

verses.sanskrit: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम शिलानां प्लवनं यथा । निश्चेष्टस्तद्रणे राजञ्छिखण्डी समतिष्ठत ॥११॥
verses.english: Then he covered him suddenly who was approaching with straight arrows. This was indeed wonderful. We then, O king, beheld a wonderful spectacle like the flying of rocks. And Shikhandin remained inactive in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: कृपेण च्छादितं दृष्ट्वा नृपोत्तमशिखण्डिनम् । प्रत्युद्ययौ कृपं तूर्णं धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः ॥१२॥
verses.english: Beholding Shikhandin covered with arrows by Kripa, O foremost of kings, the mighty carwarrior Dhristadyumna speedily approached him.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नं ततो यान्तं शारद्वतरथं प्रति । प्रतिजग्राह वेगेन कृतवर्मा महारथः ॥१३॥
verses.english: Thereupon the mighty car-warrior Kritavarma vehemently resisted Dhristadyumna who was advancing towards the son of Sharadvata.

verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिरमथायान्तं शारद्वतरथं प्रति । सपुत्रं सहसैन्यं च द्रोणपुत्रो न्यवारयत् ॥१४॥
verses.english: Drona's son then resisted Yudhishthira who was advancing with his own son and arms against the son of Sharadvata.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलं सहदेवं च त्वरमाणौ महारथौ । प्रतिजग्राह ते पुत्रः शरवर्षेण वारयन् ॥१५॥
verses.english: Your son then impeded with a downpour of arrows the approach of the two car-warriors Nakula and Sahadeva.

verses.sanskrit: भीमसेनं करूषांश्च केकयान्सह सृञ्जयैः । कर्णो वैकर्तनो युद्धे वारयामास भारत ॥१६॥
verses.english: Karna, the son of Vikartana, O descendant of Bharata, then resisted in battle Bhimasena, Karushas, Kaikeyas and Srinjayas.

verses.sanskrit: शिखण्डिनस्ततो बाणान्कृपः शारद्वतो युधि । प्राहिणोत्त्वरया युक्तो दिधक्षुरिव मारिष ॥१७॥
verses.english: Then in the battle, O Sire, Kripa quickly hurled arrows at Shikhandin as to burn him down.

verses.sanskrit: ताञ्छरान्प्रेषितांस्तेन समन्तात्स्वर्णभूषितान् । चिच्छेद खड्गमाविध्य भ्रामयंश्च पुनः पुनः ॥१८॥
verses.english: Whirling his sword repeatedly (Shikhandin) then with his sword cut-off all those golddecked arrows that were discharged at him.

verses.sanskrit: शतचन्द्रं च तच्चर्म गौतमस्तस्य भारत । व्यधमत्सायकैस्तूर्णं तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः ॥१९॥
verses.english: The son of Gautama then quickly cut-off with his arrows the shield of Prishata's son that was adorned with a hundred moons. At this his people made a loud uproar.

verses.sanskrit: स विचर्मा महाराज खड्गपाणिरुपाद्रवत् । कृपस्य वशमापन्नो मृत्योरास्यमिवातुरः ॥२०॥
verses.english: Deprived of his shield, O monarch and brought under the influence of Kripa, he, with his sword, advanced like a sick man advancing towards death.

verses.sanskrit: शारद्वतशरैर्ग्रस्तं क्लिश्यमानं महाबलः । चित्रकेतुसुतो राजन्सुकेतुस्त्वरितो ययौ ॥२१॥
verses.english: O king, Chitraketu's son Suketu quickly proceeded towards the highly powerful (Shikhandin) who was thus distressed and assailed by the son of Sharadvata.

verses.sanskrit: विकिरन्ब्राह्मणं युद्धे बहुभिर्निशितैः शरैः । अभ्यापतद‌मेयात्मा गौतमस्य रथं प्रति ॥२२॥
verses.english: Having covered in battle the Brahmana with sharp arrows, that one of immeasurable energy, advanced towards the car of Gautama's son.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा च युक्तं तं युद्धे ब्राह्मणं चरितव्रतम् । अपयातस्ततस्तूर्णं शिखण्डी राजसत्तम ॥२३॥
verses.english: Beholding that Brahmana, observant of vows thus engaged in battle, Shikhandin, O king, quickly proceeded there.

verses.sanskrit: सुकेतुस्तु ततो राजन् गौतमं नवभिः शरैः । विद्ध्वा विव्याध सप्तत्या पुनश्चैनं त्रिभिः शरैः ॥२४॥
verses.english: O king, having pierced the son of Gautama with nine arrows Suketu once more pierced him with seventy and again with three.

verses.sanskrit: अथास्य सशरं चापं पुनश्चिच्छेद मारिष । सारथिं च शरेणास्य भृशं मर्मस्वताडयत् ॥२५॥
verses.english: He then cut-off his bow and arrows; then with another he pierced greatly his driver to the very vitals.

verses.sanskrit: गौतमस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो धनुर्गुह्य नवं दृढम् । सुकेतुं त्रिंशता बाणैः सर्वमर्मस्वताडयत् ॥२६॥
verses.english: Thereupon worked up with anger Gautama took up a fresh and strong bow and cut-off Suketu to the very vital part with thirty arrows.

verses.sanskrit: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गः प्रचचाल रथोत्तमे । भूमिकंपे यथा वृक्षश्चचाल कम्पितो भृशम् ॥२७॥
verses.english: All his limbs were weakened and he shook on that best of cars as a tree trembles greatly during an earth quake.

verses.sanskrit: चलतस्तस्य कायात्तु शिरो ज्वलितकुण्डलम् । सोष्णीषं सशिरस्त्राणं क्षुरप्रेण त्वपातयत् ॥२८॥
verses.english: Then with a razor-sharpened arrow he sundered from body his head still trembling with shining ear-rings, crown and headprotector.

verses.sanskrit: तच्छिरः प्रापतद्भूमौ श्येनाहृतमिवामिषम् । ततोऽस्य कायो वसुधां पश्चात्प्रापतदच्युत ॥२९॥
verses.english: His head fell down on the earth like a piece of meant stolen away by a hawk, afterwards his body, O Eternal one, fell down on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन् हते महाराज त्रस्तास्तस्य पुरोगमाः । गौतमं समरे त्यक्त्वा दुद्रुवुस्ते दिशो दश ॥३०॥
verses.english: O Emperor, when he was slain, all his followers, leaving behind the son of Gautama in the battle-field fled, away in ten directions.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नं तु समरे सन्निवार्य महारथः । कृतवर्माऽब्रवीद्धृष्टस्तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति भारत ॥३१॥
verses.english: Encircling the highly powerful Dhristadyumna in the battle-field Kritavarma said to him-"Wait! wait!"

verses.sanskrit: तदभूत्तुमुलं युद्धं वृष्णिपार्षतयो रणे । आमिषार्थे यथा युद्धं श्येनयोः क्रुद्धयोर्नृप ॥३२॥
verses.english: Then there took place a terrible and wonderful encounter between the Vrishnis and Parsatas like that of two angry hawks, O king, for a piece of meat.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु समरे हार्दिक्यं नवभिः शरैः । आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धः पीडयन् हृदिकात्मजम् ॥३३॥
verses.english: Worked up with anger, Dhristadyumna, in that battle, assailed Hridika's son violently and struck him on the chest with nine arrows.

verses.sanskrit: कृतवर्मा तु समरे पार्षतेन दृढाहतः । पार्षतं सरथं साश्वं छाद‌यामास सायकैः ॥३४॥
verses.english: Thus Assailed by a Parohata in battle Kritavarma covered him, his chariot and horses with arrows.

verses.sanskrit: सरथश्छादितो राजन् धृष्टद्युम्नो न दृश्यते । मेघैरिव परिच्छन्नो भास्करो जलधारिभिः ॥३५॥
verses.english: O king, thus covered along with his car Dhristadyumna became invisible like the sun enshrouded by clouds surcharged with water.

verses.sanskrit: विधूय तं बाणगणं शरैः कनकभूषणैः । व्यरोचत रणे राजन् धृष्टद्युम्नः कृतव्रणः ॥३६॥
verses.english: Withstanding him with gold feathered arrows, O king, Dhristadyumna appeared in battle with wounds.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्तु पार्षतः क्रुद्धः शस्त्रवृष्टिं सुदारुणाम् । कृतवर्माणमासाद्य व्यसृजत्पृतनापतिः ॥३७॥
verses.english: Obtaining Kritavarma, Parsata, the commander of the forces, worked up with anger, made a terrible downpour of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: तामापतन्तीं सहसा शस्त्रवृष्टिं सुदारुणाम् । शरैरनेकसाहस्रैर्हार्दिक्योऽवारयद्युधि ॥३८॥
verses.english: In that battle Hridika's son with many thousand arrows, all on a sudden, dispelled that highly dreadful shower of arrows that was about to fall on him.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा तु वारितां युद्धे शस्त्रवृष्टिं दुरासदाम् । कृतवर्माणमासाद्य वारयामास पार्षतः ॥३९॥
verses.english: Beholding in that battle that fearful downpour of arrows thus dispelled by him Prishata's son, approaching Kritavarma, withstood him.

verses.sanskrit: सारथिं चास्य तरसा प्राहिणोद्यमसादनम् । भल्लेन शितधारेण स हतः प्रापतद्रथात् ॥४०॥
verses.english: With a sharpened spike he dispatched his charioteer to the abode of Death. Slain he fell down from the chariot.

verses.sanskrit: धृष्टद्युम्नस्तु बलवाञ्जित्वा शत्रुं महाबलम् । कौरवान्समरे तूर्णं वारयामास सायकैः ॥४१॥
verses.english: Having vanquished his highly powerful enemy, the mighty Dhristadyumna speedily withstood the Kauravas in battle with arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततस्ते तावका योधा धृष्टद्युम्नमुपाद्रवन् । सिंहनादरवं कृत्वा ततो युद्धमवर्तत ॥४२॥
verses.english: Thereupon emitting leonine roars your warriors ran towards Dhristadyumna and again an encounter took place.
